notes.sowing: Plant dormant canes in early spring, as soon as the soil can be worked, with the top roots no more than {cm:5} below the surface. Space plants {cm:40} to {cm:60} apart in rows about {cm:200} apart.
notes.care: Grow along posts and wires. Summer-fruiting types fruit on last year's canes: cut fruited canes to the ground after harvest and tie in the new ones. Fall-bearing types fruit on this year's canes: cut all canes to near ground level in late winter. Keep soil pH 5.6 to 6.5 and mulch to hold moisture.
notes.harvest: Summer types crop from their second summer for about six weeks. Fall-bearing types often crop in their first year, from late summer until frost. Pick every 3 to 4 days, when berries slip easily off the core.
